page.layout: One title page, centred. Top: printer's title in spaced capitals. Middle: title lines in roman, italic and capital type. Centre: a woodcut in an ornamental frame with a Greek legend around it. Below the woodcut: the printer's imprint, then the date in old-style numerals.

main_text.l: Animadversiones ad controversiam sextam Christianæ fidei,

page.notes: The large "2" at the top right is a later handwritten number, so it is left out. The woodcut is an ornamental frame around a figure with a Greek legend; the legend is printed but I could not read it, so it is marked illegible. The title line "Anisopiacenole" is uncertain (marked [?]). The hyphen after "CON-" and "Ie-" is taken as printed. The date is printed as cIↄ Iↄ cIII and is given as MDCIII.
